bugs.error_message: Canva answered, but without a picture or a design BrandPilot could read. Check your Canva account before trying again. (canva_unreadable)
bugs.root_cause: Canva's MCP generate-image answered isError:false with structuredContent { status: "failed", failure: { code: "quota_exceeded" } } and _meta["com.canva/aiCreditQuotaError"] ("You have exceeded your credit quota."). callTool only treated isError:true as a failure, so the answer went on as a success with no design or picture and was labelled unreadable.
bugs.fix: failureOf(result) detects status "failed" / failure / the credit-quota meta even without isError; callTool throws canva_credits (402) with Canva's words and the reset date (quota_usage.resets_at). Generate-all already stops on credits.
